rules.notional: Every position is a simulated $100 buy at the next session's opening price, with 0.1% trading cost each way.
rules.reference_price: The regular-session close of the day you make the picks (Friday's close on Sunday night). It is used to check your target and stop and the listing rules; the simulated buy happens at the next open, so set levels with a possible overnight gap in mind.
exits: Stop: if the session's low touches your stop you're out at the stop (or at the open if it gaps below).
Target: if the high touches your target you're out at the target (or at the open if it gaps above).
Both in one session counts as the stop.
Time: out at the close when the position has been held horizon_days sessions.
SELL in your review: out at the next session's open.
rules.eligibility: NYSE/Nasdaq only, no OTC, price above $1, 20-day average volume above 500K, target above and stop below the reference close. Picks that break a rule are voided and don't score.
rules.deadline: The file must arrive by 23:59 ET on the night you make the picks. You can upload again before then; the newest file replaces the old one.

catalyst.label: Catalyst plays

compounder.label: Compounders
compounder.about: A standing book of up to 5 quality stocks held for weeks to months. Only replace names when there's a reason.

your_recent_lessons: Nine positions were stopped in one session. The 3-4% stops on high-beta AI and semis names (MU, AVGO, BE, INTC, TSM) all hit on a single sector-wide scare, so on these names I'm now using stops of at least 5-6% and not stacking several picks on the same AI theme.

All four read-through and pre-print small-cap moonshots failed. CIFR and CORZ, bought as sympathy plays on APLD's beat, faded at the open, and ANGO and TLRY fell after their prints. Moonshots now need a company-specific catalyst, not a peer's news.

Buying into a print when expectations are depressed worked: PEP bounced 3.2% off its 52-week low on the beat, and LW's beat-and-raise drift is up 3%. Low bars plus confirmed timing beat chasing momentum.

Moonshots built on an after-hours-confirmed beat worked: PENG (EPS $1.00 vs $0.75, +7% after hours) hit its target for +11.4%. Check eligibility data before submitting: my first upload of tonight's file had three picks voided (no price data, and average volume under 500K), so I now verify average volume, not just the price.

Sympathy and re-rating moonshots on big, crowded names (MRVL, CEG) were stopped at about -3% by normal intraday ranges; CEG's low was 4.7% under entry yet it closed near flat. I'm setting stops at least 5-7% below on volatile names and not leaning on 'more target raises' as a catalyst.

Holding APLD into its print cost -6% beforehand, but the print was a large beat (revenue $341.9M vs about $126M expected, adj. EPS $0.01 vs -$0.30, new 210 MW lease) and shares are up about 5% after hours, so holding through confirmed binary events can pay when the setup is skewed; I'm still keeping the number of binary-print bets small.
